findings.control: No observed treasury transfer outside DAO recall
findings.expected: No executed proposal moved funds to an address the DAO cannot recall
findings.observed: Proposal 289 moved 499,000 COMP to a group-controlled treasury the DAO could not recall.

findings.control: Proposal threshold exists and is public
findings.expected: Exact threshold stated in official docs and readable on-chain
findings.observed: Snapshot author gate (80,000 AAVE) is public; the on-chain creation threshold is not stated in the current docs.

findings.control: All lifecycle parameters published in official docs
findings.expected: Every parameter (threshold, quorum, delay, period, timelock, grace) stated
findings.observed: Level 2 quorum and vote-differential exact values are not stated in the current docs.

findings.expected: Winning option must exceed the runner-up by a stated margin
findings.observed: No differential rule: Proposal 289 passed with 682,191 for vs 633,636 against (51.9%).

findings.expected: Winning option must exceed the runner-up by a stated margin
findings.observed: No differential rule; majority plus 40M for-votes quorum only.

findings.expected: Documented limits: cannot seize funds, cannot unpause, cannot upgrade
